missing: The check says 'fails a value with no status'. The scan (unstated in tests/nexus/scans.ts) only counts a record that has a scalar number among its own values, so a value held in an array is never asked for a status. Planted E passes. In the real data, src/data/optics.ts (the CIE 1931 observer and D65 tables, 14 metals' and 4 films' complex refractive index, about 20 sourced records of number arrays) has no status anywhere and the scan passes it. The same walker is used by unsourced, so these figures are also unseen there, though the file's CIE_SOURCE excuses it. Needed: the scan must treat a record or export holding a number array (or typed array) as a figure needing a status, a planted array-only record must fail, and optics.ts must be given statuses (specified for the CIE tables, measured or specified per metal from its paper).

docs/REALITY.md says 'Every record of src/data/ that holds numbers now carries a claim status', and its 'Not covered' list names only figures outside src/data/ and the three vocabulary words. It does not say that array-held figures (all of optics.ts) are unseen, so the entry overstates what was checked. Needed: either close the gap, or say it plainly in REALITY.md and C21's state column.
